visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up of a broken chocolate bar with a green filling is shown being pulled apart. Overlaid at the bottom is a man in a green and tan corduroy shirt holding a snack bag. The background is a warm orange studio wall. (2) Hands use a pink spatula to drizzle pink and white liquid chocolate into a brown silicone mold on a tray. Then, dark melted chocolate is poured over the decorative stripes and smoothed out with the spatula. (3) The man in the green/tan shirt stands in a brightly lit studio kitchen with shelves and plants. He holds a 'Science Noodle' bag, crushes it, and pours it into a silver bowl. He then adds a thick green paste and stirs it thoroughly with a spatula until it is a chunky green mixture. (4) The green mixture is spooned into the dark chocolate-lined mold and leveled. Another layer of dark melted chocolate is poured over the top, and a white scraper is used to create a flat, smooth surface. (5) The finished bar is popped out of the mold onto a wooden board. The man breaks the bar in half with his hands, showing the crunchy green interior. He takes a large bite, his eyes widen, and he laughs towards the camera. (6) Several close-up shots show the internal texture of the bar. The man stands in the kitchen, holding a piece of the chocolate and talking enthusiastically with hand gestures. He holds up the 'Science Noodle' bag again for comparison.

(2) As the narration starts describing the chocolate melting, soft scraping and liquid pouring sounds are audible over the music. (3) A distinct crinkling of a plastic bag occurs as the speaker mentions 'Science Noodles,' followed by a sharp, rhythmic crushing sound and the metallic sound of a bowl being hit. (4) The speaker's tone becomes more instructional and fast-paced, accompanied by continuous stirring and scraping sounds that sync with the visual mixing. (5) A sudden, high-pitched 'Whoosh' transition lead into a loud, crisp percussive crunching sound representing a bite, followed immediately by high-arousal, staccato laughter. (6) The video ends with the narrator speaking rapidly and confidently, emphasizing the similarity of the texture with several recurring crunchy foley sounds layered on the beat.
